rationale: The short thesis is dented but not broken — the last close sits only 2 cents above VWAP and right at the 9-EMA, well inside noise given the 1-cent spread and $0.085 ATR, and the pre-defined $15.60 invalidation has not printed. The tape still supports downside drift (SPY -0.48%, VIXY +1.56%, RV 5.47x, price at 33% of the day's range) and risk to the stop is only ~0.4%, so holding with original levels is the cheapest expression. A flip long is not justified — a single rising-volume up-close against a risk-off gap-distribution day lacks the follow-through needed to outweigh merely going flat.
